goal: Talk about being brave when things feel new
objective: Describe what bravery means and recall one time they acted bravely

blueprint.goal: Describe what bravery means and recall one time they acted bravely
successCriteria: Learner gives their own definition of bravery
Learner connects bravery to a real moment from their life

stages.objective: Warm up with what bravery feels like
stages.learnerOpportunity: Name something that feels scary but exciting

checks.questionOrTask: What is something that feels a little scary and a little exciting at the same time?

misconceptions.tactic: Share that bravery only exists when something feels scary first, then ask again.

stages.objective: Build a working definition of bravery
stages.learnerOpportunity: Improve a too-simple definition the tutor offers

checks.questionOrTask: If a friend asked you what brave means, what would you tell them?

stages.objective: Connect bravery to their own life
stages.learnerOpportunity: Tell one true story where they were brave

checks.questionOrTask: Tell me about one time you did something even though it felt scary. What happened?
